facts.headline: The Sonic Blockchain Ecosystem: Speed and Developer Incentives
facts.summary: The Sonic blockchain is courting builders with high speed and aggressive developer incentives, drawing dApps like Euler, Stability DAO, and Shadow. This looks at what makes Sonic fast, how its incentive model bootstraps an ecosystem, and whether incentivized growth survives the end of the incentives.
